claim: Patchline ships a Bayesian hierarchical model of per-team effects with posterior predictive checks. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the posterior predictive claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make bayesian-hierarchical-model-gate`.
